visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler girl with pigtails wearing a blue sweater and checkered pants stands on a light wooden floor in a living room. She picks up a patterned fabric cloth from the floor and walks toward the camera with a neutral expression. (2) She moves to a white storage cabinet and opens a drawer, pulling out a white diaper-like object. An adult's hand enters the frame from the right, and she hands the object over. (3) The toddler walks to a white trash can nearby, steps on the pedal to open the lid, and drops a different cloth inside. (4) The scene shifts to the next day; the girl is now wearing a yellow t-shirt and light blue shorts. She walks through a kitchen area picking up several pink ribbons scattered on the floor. (5) She moves to a desk where a person is sitting, crouches down to reach under the chair, and retrieves more yellow and pink paper scraps. (6) She returns to the white trash can in the kitchen, opens it, and meticulously throws all the gathered scraps inside one by one. (7) An end card appears featuring a pink background with a cartoon illustration of the girl sitting down.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Playful, high-tempo electronic BGM with a strong percussive beat starts immediately. A male voice speaks in a warm, gentle tone with a moderate pitch. A high-pitched, melodic child voice chirps brief responses. (2) Sound of soft fabric rustling is audible under the speech. The child voice giggles. (3) A distinct mechanical click and a hollow plastic thud occur as the trash can lid opens and closes. The male voice shifts to a higher pitch and louder intensity, conveying praise. (4) In the second phase, the BGM remains constant. Sounds of rapid, rhythmic footsteps on a hard floor are heard. The child voice becomes more continuous and energetic, with high pitch variability. (5) Frequent rustling of plastic and paper scraps accompanies the child's vocalizations. Another mechanical click of the foot pedal trash can occurs. (6) The male voice asks a question with a prominent rising intonation. The child voice responds with a joyful tone. The audio concludes with a soft electronic chime as the music fades.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents the daily life of a toddler, focusing on her humorous and adorable obsession with picking up trash and throwing it away. It captures the warm interaction between the father/filmer and the child as he encourages her cleaning efforts, emphasizing the girl's sense of accomplishment.
